systems.system: Geospatial Information Management Strategy national spatial data systems and dashboards
systems.owner: Department of Planning, Monitoring and Evaluation
systems.tiers: intended for national, provincial and municipal planning; the department offers municipalities access to national spatial data systems and dashboards, with eThekwini Metropolitan Municipality hosting the roadshow; no municipality is said to be working in it

note: A speech at a roadshow for the national geospatial strategy, launched 19 September 2025. Municipal use of spatial systems is an aim, not a stated practice, and nothing states the connection of any municipal office.
